name: Big Technologies plc
summary: Operating internationally and within the United Kingdom under the Buddi brand, Big Technologies Plc specializes in remote personal monitoring solutions. For the criminal justice sector, they offer a system built around a proprietary, cloud-based software platform and modular hardware, designed for real-time location tracking and oversight. Additionally, their remote care solution centers on a wristband, providing automated fall detection, urgent alerts, precise location tracking, and continuous customer support services. Big Technologies Plc was established in 2005 and is based in Rickmansworth, UK.
